source: Imanaka H, Nishimura M, Takeuchi M, et al. Autotriggering, detection limit, and work of breathing during flow-triggered mechanical ventilation. Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2000; 161(2 Pt 1):478-483.
claim: In an apnoeic patient without spontaneous effort (Pmus 0 cmH2O, spontRate 0 bpm), an unintentional circuit leak (circuitLeakLpm 8.0 L/min) exceeding the flow trigger sensitivity threshold (triggerFlowLpm 2.0 L/min) falsely triggers the ventilator, producing runaway auto-triggering (autoTriggerCount >= 10 breaths/min).
